title: Stop Saying "It's Crooked": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for crooked? When you build your own house and it leans, it's not just crooked. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Lopsided: higher or bigger on one side
• Wonky: crooked or a bit shaky (informal, UK)
• Askew: not straight, at an angle

Ever built something like this?

Clip: One Week (1920)
